author: PodBox
body:
Hello my name is Pod! It has been honestly a tough time at Raging Invorporated, loosing a owner and some other builders but we need to get organized! I'm looking for builders that will be loyal and hard working and that can show organization skills and if so, I may promote them to team manager and such.  

Application:

1. Why do you want to join Rage Inc.?
2. In your own mind, how trust worthy do you think you are?
3. Picture of your 2 best builds
4. What good can u bring to Raging Inc.? (Responsibility, Organization, etc.)
5. Age

Must have Skype, and if you want to join, make one!
